rejectedController.name: Codex In-app Browser
rejectedController.reason: The controller emitted Playwright and CUA keyboard events with isTrusted=false, so Chromium did not apply the native summary/details Enter and Space default actions.

selectedController.name: Google Chrome via ChatGPT browser extension
selectedController.reason: The controller produced the required native Enter-open and Space-close state transitions on the same synthetic fixture while all runtime counts remained zero.

stopRuleEffect: The in-app controller was rejected rather than treating unchanged keyboard state as a pass; no canary rendering was attempted.
